corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
import secrets

router = APIRouter(prefix="/crdt/signaling")

@router.post("/rooms/{room_id}/peer-token")
async def generate_crdt_peer_connection_token(
    room_id: str,
    signaling_service: SignalingService = Depends(get_signaling_service),
    room_auth: RoomAuthService = Depends(get_room_auth_service),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    if not await room_auth.is_member(user_id=current_user.id, room_id=room_id):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: You are not authorized to join this room")

    room_exists = await signaling_service.room_exists(room_id)
    if not room_exists:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Signaling room not registered")

    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    await signaling_service.register_peer(room_id, peer_id=current_user.id, token=token)
    return {"room_id": room_id, "peer_token": token, "ice_servers": signaling_service.get_ice_servers()}
